2. Current traction (400 subs in 6 months) — Slide 2 ✓
3. Unit economics (18 EUR/month) — Slide 2 ✓

- Unsubstantiated growth projections — none present ✓

Blocking criteria:
- Untraced factual claim
- Invented customers, testimonials, quotes, awards
- Placeholder text
- Must_include item missing
- Fewer than 6 content slides
